scope: Default-off one-chunk-ahead PLE gather/dequant using exact full-prompt hash precomputation, the second pinned ring buffer, and one worker thread

amdahl.O: host PLE gather/dequant and publication nested in complete prefill wall
amdahl.overlap_exclusions: complete prefill wall already includes hashing, worker creation/join, gather/dequant, H2D, and GPU work; telemetry subwindows are not additive
amdahl.strict_fallback: serial chunk-local hash/gather/dequant remains the sole production path

mechanism.lookahead: The complete prompt is known, so all exact PLE hash rows can be computed before chunk 0 without semantic prediction.
mechanism.ownership: One worker stages the next chunk into the inactive pinned ring while the main thread submits current-chunk GPU work; future completion precedes reuse and H2D.
mechanism.decode: unchanged and demand-driven because generated tokens have no real lookahead

decision: Reject and remove. Exact lookahead/ownership is feasible, but the route is neutral: -0.15% at p1024 and +0.17% at p4096. This is below the 1% complete-wall iteration floor and does not justify thread/future lifecycle complexity.
